<!-- super-upstream:start -->
> [!NOTE]
> **This is the regular, unmodified [Argon theme](https://github.com/jerrykuku/luci-theme-argon) — only built super-upstream.**
>
> Every hour a workflow checks [`jerrykuku/luci-theme-argon@master`](https://github.com/jerrykuku/luci-theme-argon/commits/master).
> As soon as a new commit lands there, this fork syncs to it and publishes fresh packages built from that exact commit
> in [Releases](https://github.com/akorshun/luci-theme-argon/releases/latest):
>
> - `.ipk` for OpenWrt 24.10 (opkg): `opkg install ./luci-theme-argon_*_all.ipk`
> - `.apk` for OpenWrt 25.12 and snapshots (apk): `apk add --allow-untrusted ./luci-theme-argon-*.apk`
>
> `luci-app-argon-config` (latest `master`) is built alongside. No theme code is changed here — report theme bugs upstream.
<!-- super-upstream:end -->
